webster.text: Unwearied; not tired; not exhausted by labor; not yielding to fatigue; as indefatigable exertions; indefatigable attendance or perseverance.

example.quote: I hope you will avail yourself and your country of that extensive learning and indefatigable industry which you possess, to assist her in the formation of the happiest governments and the best character of a great people.
example.cite: John Adams, Thoughts on Government, Applicable to the Present State of the American Colonies (Philadelphia 1776)
